searchText: Hi <@543900561460822016> is there any update regarding the agenda of https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/883 . We wanted to discuss miner to miner communication and wondering if it is possible to do it in this call? what kind of miner to miner communication you would want to integrate into the devp2p layer? Actually we were researching on current miner to miner communication wrt to a private blockchain solution to analyse security concerns for data transmitted. And wanted to discuss/ask some things i’m not sure this call is going to be right place to do that. if you have questions or proposals I would send them in this channel and if there is engagement / it’s applicable to mainnet we could open it for discussion on the call!
